name: Hall of Arms (Northshire)
label: Place
description: In Northshire Abbey, recruits train with the Stormwind Army in the Hall of Arms, south of the Main Hall.
intro: In Northshire Abbey, recruits train with the Stormwind Army in the Hall of Arms, south of the Main Hall.

p: The Hall of Arms rings with blunted steel and the measured cadence of instruction. South of Northshire Abbey’s Main Hall, the wing trains human fighters and devout aspirants who take up arms for the Stormwind Army. Veteran battle instructors and paladin mentors teach the postures and disciplines needed to defend Elwynn Forest from kobolds, Defias bandits, and gnoll raiders. Across the courtyard, clerics and scholars study ancient tomes in the Library Wing.
